description: This file implements an Android Debug Bridge (ADB) client over WebSocket, providing functions to establish connections, send commands, handle messages, and manage connection lifecycle for debugging or device control purposes.

methods.name: setU32LE
methods.description: Sets a 32-bit unsigned integer in a Uint8Array at a specified offset in little-endian format.

methods.name: getU32LE
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit unsigned integer from a Uint8Array at a specified offset in little-endian format.

methods.name: computeChecksum
methods.description: Calculates a simple checksum by summing all bytes in a Uint8Array.

methods.name: createAdbMessage
methods.description: Constructs an ADB protocol message as an ArrayBuffer with command, arguments, checksum, and payload.

methods.name: adbOpenConnection
methods.description: Initiates an ADB connection by sending a connect message with device identity.

methods.name: adbShell
methods.description: Sends a shell command over the ADB connection.

methods.name: adbSendOkay
methods.description: Sends an 'OKAY' message to acknowledge receipt or establish a channel.

methods.name: awaitConnection
methods.description: Manages connection timeout and invokes the disconnected callback if timeout occurs.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles actions upon successful connection establishment.

methods.name: adbOnMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming ADB messages, handling connection, data, and errors.

methods.name: init_adb
methods.description: Initializes the ADB WebSocket connection, sets up message handlers, and starts the connection process.
